title: Graceful disconnect: a client leaves through the game's own Disconnect() and is gone for everyone
description: S08's world without the kill: client 2 walks away for 6 s (about 30 units, inside the 50-unit area of interest of every other client) and leaves at 15 s with the plan action quit (client hook C6: NetworkClient.Disconnect(), the player's own way out; ReconnectPolicy does not fire) and does not come back. Its run ends with outcome left. The server must drop its player entity, and the other clients must remove it, within 5 s: far below the 60 s KCP idle timeout that cleans up a silent client, so the leave is not mistaken for a crash.
